title.zh: 扩大东内格罗斯省Mabinay市镇辖区的法案
title.en: An Act Enlarging the Territory of the Municipality of Mabinay, Province of Negros Oriental
title.orig: An Act Enlarging the Territory of the Municipality of Mabinay, Province of Negros Oriental

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1966/ra_4818_1966.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The barrios of Pandanon, Dahili, Samac, and Namangka in the Municipality of Manjuyod, and the barrios of Tara, Campanon-an, Pantao, Cansaling, Dagbasan, Bagtic, Mayaposi, and Mambaja in the Municipality of Bais, all in the Province of Negros Oriental, are separated from said municipalities and are transferred and made part of the Municipality of Mabinay.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1966.
